Our story

We’re a couple of foodies who are always looking for the most delicious food to eat. We have a passion for hospitality and believe that eating out is about the whole experience, not just the quality of food (though the food must be amazing!). This burger bar has been a long-time dream, now become a reality, and it’s filled with many of our favourite burgers and sides (especially Joel’s famous buffalo wings!). We can’t wait to serve you! Early on we decided we wanted our food to cater to as many as possible. One of our closest friends is coeliac and it’s always a mission finding a place to eat with decent gluten free options! With some solid vegetarian and vegan options, and particularly making everything on our menu gluten friendly, we believe there really is something here for everyone. Another passion for us was to support local as much as we could, and you’ll find we’ve done just that. Almost all our providers are local NZ businesses. Our third goal was to be environmentally sustainable. From Fairtrade organic coffee to eco-friendly packaging, we’ve worked hard to care for the environment as we make you delicious food.

Mel and Joel

Initiatives & partners

New Zealand / Buying Local

Wherever we can we strive to ensure everything we buy comes from New Zealand. It is so important to us that when you buy from us, you’re not only supporting the local Burger Bar, but you are supporting local growers and other businesses. This knock-on effect we believe will help NZ’s economy and help get as many kiwis employed as possible.

We believe in NZ product so much we don’t do anything to change it, meaning when you eat our chicken you can know that it is 100% free range chicken tenderloins dipped in our batter. Our meat patties are 100% beef with a pinch of salt because, let’s be honest, NZ product is amazing just the way it is.

Gluten / vegan & vegetarian friendly

We believe that when you choose to eat out, everyone should have a variety of options available to choose from.

Gluten friendly

Our best mate is coeliac, and we always saw how much of a struggle it was for her to find something on the menu she could eat, and how careful she had to be. It didn’t sit right with us, and on top of that, trying to find a good burger place that can easily cater to gluten intolerance is not easy.

We have ensured all of our products except the buns are gluten free, or have no added gluten. And we have sourced an amazing gluten free (and vegan!) bun for those who cannot consume gluten (or are looking for a vegan option). When these allergies come up in our food truck, we ensure we change gloves, and even toast your GF bun separately, before making your order. Please note these gluten free buns are all individually wrapped, grilled in a gluten free oven and put into a box to ensure its not touching gluten crumbs or mixing with our glutenous buns.

 We add nothing but salt to our meat patties, our batters are made from rice flour, all sauces are gluten free or have no added gluten and we’ve checked every product right down to our pickles (which aren’t always GF due to the type of vinegar used) to make sure you don’t have to worry about eating at Stacked. Please talk to our friendly cashier team if you fall under this category.

Vegan & vegetarian friendly

It has been getting a lot easier to find meals that are vegan these days, but we always thought that burger bars did not really excel in this area. We decided to make burgers that we believe hit the nail on the head.

The sauces we use have been specifically chosen to be vegan friendly, as well as our batters, cheese and buns, meaning you can enjoy our food with peace of mind knowing you are getting what you ask for. 

On top of this we believe in being able to have drinks that are vegan friendly. We have vegan options in our bottled, frappe and smoothie range, and even our hot chocolate is vegan certified! So you can enjoy a hot chocolate, mocha or even try our new mint flavoured hot chocolate resting assured it’s vegan. Milk: We offer soya, almond and oat options to be used instead of our Jersey Girls A2 milk. Please ask what options are vegan when you are next in store! 

Halal

Our meat is sourced from a local certified halal supplier. We do have pork, however this is cooked in a separate frying pan.

Karma Drinks

When we searched for bottled product to sell, we knew we found a company to back when we came across Karma Drinks. They stand for everything we believe in. They believe their drinks should not only taste good, but be good to the planet, the people who grow their ingredients and you!

To hold them to account to their mission to be the world’s most ethical soft drink they established the Karma Foundation. 1% of revenue from every Karma Drink goes to their Cola nut growers and their communities in Sierra Leone.

Not only this, Karma want the best for the environment by standing against plastic, something we strongly believe in. They also believe in organic, ensuring less toxins and other nasties can end up in your drink. Every sip you take you can sip assured you are drinking quality.

Learn more about the Karma Foundation

Kokako Coffee

We source our coffee from our local roaster up in Mt Eden. We love what they stand for and have partnered with them for several reasons: 

  • Coffee Cups & Lids: These are compostable which is so important to us. Most coffee cups that say biodegradable or recycling don’t actually make their way to any sort of recycling facility, instead ending up in the landfill. Because these are compostable, we are able to commercially compost them through Green Gorilla to ensure we give back positively to the environment.

  • Mahana Coffee: Kokako’s Mahana coffee is Fair Trade & Biogro Organic certified, and has a full bodied chocolatey flavour. The coffee beans are sourced from Fairtrade Organic cooperatives in Ethiopia, Sumatra & the Democratic Republic of Congo. Honestly, we haven’t tasted better coffee than this!

Bon Accord

We have partnered with Bon Accord to bring you our beautiful Frappes, Real Fruit Pulp smoothies, Iced Tea and other hot beverages. 

We are proud to be partnered with Bon Accord. One of our favourite things we stock is their Bon Accord Fairtrade Vegan Beglian Style Hot Chocolate. This is designed for any hot chocolate lover and is hands down what we believe to be the best hot chocolate out there on the market. It delivers a rich, dark hot chocolate experience, and you can enjoy with peace of mind knowing it’s benefiting families at the origin.  

Green Gorilla Composting and Recycling Program

It was important to us to be as environmentally friendly as we possibly could.

Our food packaging is all recyclable and/or biodegradable/compostable, and to help us make sure our product ends up in a better place we have partnered with Green Gorilla.

Green Gorilla

  • Are the only comprehensive Waste Processing Facility in New Zealand

  • Diverts over 75,000 tonnes of waste per annum away from Auckland's landfills

Recycling Program

  • We choose specifically to only have glass bottled products, which we recycle through Green Gorilla along with the rest of our recycling.

Compostable Program

  • All of our packaging from boxes, bags, wraps, coffee grounds and coffee cups to straws and stickers is compostable. (The only thing we’ve found isn’t compostable is our receipt paper! We are currently looking into alternatives.)

  • Onsite we ensure all food waste/scraps and your burger packaging (should you eat your meal onsite) is sent to Green Gorilla who ensure it is commercially composted, helping reduce methane gas and diverting rubbish from the landfill.

Deliver Easy

Deliver Easy is a New Zealand owned delivery company that came into Auckland in August 2020. We have joined forces because we love how they treat their drivers! They ensure their drivers get (at minimum) the living wage. They’re a New Zealand owned and operated business, so when you order a Stacked Burger Bar delivery through them, you’re helping support our NZ economy – it’s a no brainer!

Parties, Weddings, Funerals and more...

Rooms Available

  • Auditorium (seating 135)

    The auditorium is an ideal space for corporate events, intimate weddings/funerals or charity event nights. This room has the ability to be closed off from the café or open out onto the café area.

  • Hall (seating 50)

    This is a great room to celebrate birthdays, anniversaries or baby showers. With the ability to hire this room and the Deck for an overflow space it makes this a popular hire space.

  • Café & Foyer (seating 20)

    For smaller corporate events, baby showers or as an addition to other areas, this is a great area for hire. Barista’s available to hire to make coffees (or anything from our drinks menu) and/or serve food from our café.

  • Covered Deck (seating 80)

    A great space all year around, with shaded canopy & retractable wind shields. With the ability to have the space open or closed to the elements it allows for your event to go ahead no matter the weather.
